topic.title: RBI raises the repo rate: what it means for a fixed deposit saver

title: Repo rate is up. Here is what it means for your savings
description: The RBI raised the repo rate this month. A look at what a rate move can mean for savers, with an assumed 7% on a one-time deposit. Rates are assumptions, not assured. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: Tell us your loan type in the comments

lines.text: The RBI just raised the repo rate.
That is the rate banks borrow at from the RBI.
Floating loans may reset. Deposit rates could change too, lender by lender.
Say five lakh rupees locked for five years at seven percent: it could become seven lakh rupees.
The rate is news. Your plan is the story. Tell us your loan type below.
